title: Rainy 1950s Jazz & Cozy Window | Black Cat, Candlelight & Relaxing Ambience
still_prompt: A cozy vintage interior seen from inside, at dusk on a rainy autumn day, drawn as a hand-inked storybook illustration: bold clean black ink outlines over flat, softly shaded colour, warm limited palette of amber, rust, olive green and deep brown, like a 1950s picture book. A wide wooden windowsill runs across the lower third of the frame in front of a large multi-pane wooden window. On the right third of the sill a black cat sits with its back to the viewer, upright, looking out of the window, its long tail resting along the sill; the cat is a solid black silhouette with a thin warm rim of light. Just left of the cat, a steaming coffee cup on a saucer with a soft curl of steam. Left of the cup, a glass jar lantern holding three lit pillar candles glowing warm orange. Further left along the sill, three terracotta pots with dried autumn plants with orange leaves, and a small brass candle holder with a lit candle near the left edge. A trailing plant hangs from the top right corner. A few fallen leaves scattered on the sill. Through the window: soft rain streaks and droplets on the glass, a grey-green overcast sky, wet garden shrubs, and across the lane a neighbouring brick cottage with one warmly lit window. Small framed botanical pictures on the warm ochre wall at the top left. Calm, cozy, nostalgic, quiet. 16:9 wide composition, lots of fine detail, no people, no text, no watermark, no border.
clip_prompt_common: The camera is completely locked off: no zoom, no pan, no camera movement at all. Keep the exact hand-inked illustration style, line work and colours of the image. Only these things move, gently and slowly: the candle flames flicker softly, the steam curls up from the cup, raindrops slide down the window glass, and the black cat. Everything else in the room stays perfectly still. Calm, cozy, quiet mood. No new objects, no people, no text.
clip_prompts: The black cat slowly sweeps its tail back and forth along the windowsill while it keeps looking out at the rain, then settles back into its starting pose.
The black cat turns its head a little to the left to watch a raindrop on the glass, twitches one ear, then slowly turns back to look straight out of the window, ending in its starting pose.
The black cat breathes calmly, its tail tip curling and uncurling on the sill, and its ears swivel slightly toward a sound outside, then everything returns to the starting pose.
The black cat lowers its head slightly to look down at the wet garden, then lifts it again and its tail swishes once, ending exactly in its starting pose.
The black cat sits still and calm, only its tail gently sways side to side and its whiskers twitch, the steam from the cup drifts in a slow swirl, ending in the starting pose.
